links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid reading grade level of ChatGPT responses to breast cancer surgery questions
links.effect: Median FKGL was 11.2 (high school reading level), exceeding recommended readability levels for patient-directed materials.
links.quote: While most responses were technically accurate, the complexity of language exceeded the recommended readability levels for patient-directed materials.
